subject: mathematics
content: Let the line $$\frac{x-3}{7}=\frac{y-2}{-1}=\frac{z-3}{-4}$$ intersect the plane containing the lines $$\frac{x-4}{1}=\frac{y+1}{-2}=\frac{z}{1}$$ and $$4 a x-y+5 z-7 a=0=2 x-5 y-z-3, a \in \mathbb{R}$$ at the point $$P(\alpha, \beta, \gamma)$$. Then the value of $$\alpha+\beta+\gamma$$ equals _____________.
